name: Amagi Azusa
source:
Born on July 13, 1989.
A petite girl who is a member of the drama club. She has distinctive glasses and braided ponytails. She is usually calm and gentle, but she also has a strict side. [url=/c136002]Kurobe Tetsurou[/url], who has feelings for her, calls her "[url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/あずさ_(列車)]Super Azusa[/url]-chan," but she's a bit confused about his favoritism. She sometimes shows signs of having feelings for Takachiho Makoto.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
